name: ryu.output-styles
description: The six built-in output styles — ELI5, I have ADHD, Explanatory, Learning, Proactive and Plain text. A style is appended to (or replaces) the agent's base instructions for the turn, so it changes how the agent talks — role, tone, default response shape — and never what it knows, which tools it has, or which model runs. Pick one in the composer; browse them in the Store's Output Styles tab.
